reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was "Every batch lab-tested" with a QR code on the front, and anyone can print that. I already have a magnesium I trust with an NSF or USP seal, and a new brand with zero reviews is not going to replace it.
objection: No NSF or USP seal and no reviews. A QR code to the brand's own lab report is not the same as third-party certification, and I have already tried three magnesiums this year, so I am not gambling on a fourth unknown.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP certification on the box, or a few hundred verified reviews from people who have used it for months.
